The UK’s Leading David Attenborough Voiceover Artist – Heard Worldwide

Looking for a realistic David Attenborough voiceover? You’ve found it. Recognised as one of the UK’s most trusted Attenborough sound-a-likes, my impression has been heard across TV, radio, games, trailers, explainer videos, and viral campaigns. Always delivered with respect, humour, and the detail clients expect.

Where You’ve Heard My Attenborough Voice

My David Attenborough impression has been heard on social media campaigns, the viral Biffa video, and across video games including Horizon Zero Dawn.

Projects like Cracking Ice, a tongue-in-cheek parody of nature docs, or the Natural Instincts trailer.

From commercials and trailers to character voiceover work and cartoons, delivered with professionalism and humour. My Attenborough voice also works brilliantly for commercial voiceover campaigns.

David Attenborough Voice Showreel – Guy Harris

Common Questions About My Attenborough Voice

Is David Attenborough’s voice AI? No. While there are AI versions out there, my impression is a natural performance, grounded in years of professional voiceover experience. I deliver nuance, timing and warmth that no algorithm can fully capture.

Where have people heard your Attenborough impression? Across TV, games, trailers, social virals, and more. From lighthearted social media videos to serious narration worldwide.

Can you record live with direction? Absolutely. I record with clients over Zoom or Cleanfeed, so you can direct in real time. The final read is then exactly as you imagined it. All delivered in broadcast-quality audio the same day.
